scope: CPU-only project source and saved logs; no live service restart, GPU request, game action or machine-wide command-line scan
conclusion: Historical exit causes remain unknown. Diagnostics added for future launches, not active resident processes.

mainEvidence.savedStdoutContent: Startup line only; no shutdown line
mainEvidence.limitation: Absence of exception/shutdown text cannot distinguish forced termination, native crash, lost diagnostic output, or another unobserved exit. Saved old files remain valid evidence even though current logs/server.* were later overwritten.

modelEvidence.tail: HTTP 200 access lines; no request timestamps inside access lines
modelEvidence.stderrTail: Model startup and generation-option warning; no traceback or shutdown record
modelEvidence.limitation: File modification time is not an exact process exit time. Simultaneous absence of wrapper and child is insufficient to establish termination order or cause.

sourceFindings: restart-main.ps1 uses Stop-Process -Force and redirects new starts into fixed stdout/stderr files. This is a possible route to missing shutdown logs, not evidence that it caused either incident.
start-local-llm.ps1 previously waited for uvicorn without saving the native exit code or append-only lifecycle evidence.
server.js previously recorded only console SIGINT/SIGTERM shutdown messages and no persistent exit/fatal monitor.
changes: src/runtime/process-lifecycle.js: synchronous append-only start/ready/shutdown_requested/exit/uncaughtExceptionMonitor events, with PID/parent PID/start timestamp. No uncaughtException or unhandledRejection handler; fatal behavior unchanged. No messages, stacks, argv, environment or prompts in lifecycle records.
src/server.js: installs monitor before application initialization, records ready and existing shutdown entry; no automatic restart or bot action.

scripts/lib/process-lifecycle.ps1 and scripts/start-local-llm.ps1: append native_start_requested/native_wait_finished with wrapper PID/run ID, exact LASTEXITCODE captured immediately after native return, exception type only, rethrow launcher errors and propagate native exit code.
tests: node tests/process-lifecycle.js: PASS; real child normal/fatal/rejected-Promise exit codes, append preservation, private error message excluded, listener cleanup, actual PowerShell wrapper sequence with CPU-only Node child exit17
deployment: Source only; no resident service, bot or training restart performed.
limits: Force kill, process-tree termination, OS termination or native process abort can prevent exit/finally execution. A missing final event is not proof of a particular cause.
Lifecycle diagnostic I/O failure is intentionally nonfatal and can leave missing records.
The PowerShell logging applies to launches through start-local-llm.ps1, not arbitrary direct uvicorn launches.
No evidence supports attributing these exits to GPU training or model inference.
